title: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Dairy Mayrhofen
name: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Dairy Mayrhofen
kurzbeschreibung: The ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen: show dairy across 6,000 m², show farm with animals, and tastings of genuine Tyrolean hay milk.
beschreibung:
Overview

The family-run ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal is situated at the entrance of the market town of Mayrhofen in the rear Zillertal (district of Schwaz) at an altitude of around 630 meters above sea level. As a traditional family business, the company has for generations processed exclusively fresh, daily hay milk from regional mountain farms. Spanning over 6,000 square meters of adventure area, the modern show dairy provides a transparent glass production facility where visitors can witness every step from the alpine pasture to the finished premium cheese up close.

Glass Dairy & Show Farm

On the self-guided tour through the Schaukäserei, visitors look through huge glass panes directly into the production halls and the impressive aging cellars, where thousands of cheese wheels mature and are turned by modern care robots. Informative audio guides and multimedia stations in multiple languages provide fascinating insights into the strict criteria of Heumilch g.t.S. (Traditional Speciality Guaranteed) and the fine craft of cheesemaking. Directly adjoining the dairy is the spacious SchauBauernhof: here families can encounter contented dairy cows, calves, goats, sheep, and chickens in animal-friendly keeping, complemented by a large mini-tractor course and an adventure playground. The crowning highlight of the tour is the Genuss-Verkostung (tasting session), where guests can sample various aging stages of Zillertaler Bergkäse, Graukäse, as well as fresh fruit yogurts and buttermilk.

Visit & Getting There

The ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal is open year-round from Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 17:00 (closed on Sundays; last admission to the adventure world at 16:00). Admission prices including the show dairy, show farm, and tasting (as of the 2025/2026 season): adults approx. €13.50, children and youth (6 to 15 years) approx. €6.80, small children free; family ticket approx. €30.00. Holders of the Zillertal Activcard receive a discount. The farm shop and the restaurant Sennereiküche are freely accessible without an admission ticket. Getting there by car: Via the B169 valley road to Mayrhofen, follow the signage to the facility at Hollenzen 116 (large free customer parking lot). By public transport: Take the Zillertalbahn to Mayrhofen station, from there approx. 15 minutes on foot or by local bus directly to the entrance.

Tips

The entire complex of the ErlebnisSennerei and the SchauBauernhof is barrier-free and steplessly accessible for wheelchairs and strollers. In the farm shop, vacuum-packed hay milk cheeses, hay milk butter, and regional delicacies can be purchased directly from the producer — the perfect souvenir to take home.
